results.title: Trump explodes at CNN reporter after question about his young blonde aide
results.description: President Donald Trump clashed with CNN senior White House correspondent Kristen Holmes during an Oval Office press conference on 17 August.

results.title: Trump threatens to 'bomb the s**t' out of Oman if it gets in way of Iran deal
results.description: Trump has threatened to bomb Oman if it interferes with a US deal with Iran over the Strait of Hormuz, as pressure mounts to end the nearly six-month conflict.
